name: sparkx-search-term-diagnosis
description: Diagnose where ad spend goes at the search-term level: tag every search term (keyword vs ASIN, branded vs non-branded, order tier), then report spend distribution, brand vs non-brand, zero-order waste with negative candidates, harvest candidates for exact match, and fragmented exact keywords - with fixed, reproducible rules and thresholds derived from the store's own order value and target ACOS. Read-only; execution goes to sparkx-edit-ads. Use when the user asks "上个月钱花哪了", "帮我找一批该否的词", "自动广告里哪些词值得单独投", "search term analysis", "negative keyword candidates", "harvest keywords". Not for trend recaps (sparkx-weekly-ads-report / sparkx-monthly-ads-report), campaign-type / marketplace structure (sparkx-ads-structure-analysis) or ASIN health (sparkx-product-diagnosis).
